answer_2.quote: For the evaluation metrics, we measure the agent's task failure rate (FR).

answer_3.quote: we utilize a straightforward defense strategy to counter the attacks on LLM agents by asking the core LLM whether such action can be harmful or violates its policy.

answer_4.quote: We manually examined all cases when no attack was deployed and found the false-positive rate to be only around 1.3%. We further examined around 10% of the test cases when the attacks were deployed and found the false-positive rate to be a similar 2.1%.
answer_4.guideline: We conduct random sampling with human inspection to minimize false positives in our experiments.
